rv.q: But the result, while watchable, is less White Christmas and more like a traditional British Christmas: not quite as much drama as you’d anticipated, a bit wet, and just a little bit disappointing.
This is a theatre production of the highest quality.

cn.t: This West End transfer of the Irving Berlin musical divides critics, with some finding it a spectacular holiday treat while others feel the adaptation thins out the plot and weakens the beloved film's characters.
